blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) will establish its own maritime center in Manila to serve as a regional knowledge hub and support platform for the bloc’s maritime-related initiatives, according to Foreign Affairs Secretary Maria Theresa Lazaro. In a press briefing following the Asean Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Pasay City on Saturday, Lazaro said member states had adopted the concept note and terms of reference for the proposed Asean Maritime Center, one of the key outcomes of the Philippines’ chairship of the regional bloc this year.
